website_lead_ingest.note: FRESH CODE (e30fb02 direct website lead ingest /api/ingest/lead + migration 0102). Verified live against deployed staging: (1) migration 0102 partial unique index leads_external_lead_uq ENFORCES — two service-key inserts with the same external_lead_id → 2nd fails 23505 on the named constraint (the atomic idempotency backstop the route relies on). (2) Route fails closed on auth: POST no header → 401, POST wrong bearer → 401 {ok:false,error:unauthorized}, GET → 405; matches ingestAuthorized fail-closed contract (missing/short/wrong secret all indistinguishable to caller, by design). (3) landWebsiteLead exercised against the REAL staging schema via a throwaway vitest (tests/_qa_scratch_ingest_live.test.ts, deleted, not committed): first land created a lead with status=website_enquiry, source_system=website, entry_channel=web (all valid enums on the deployed schema), name normalized away from raw lowercase, from_postcode normalized, preferred_date coerced from free-text 'ASAP' → null (no crash); second land with the SAME externalLeadId + wholly different fields returned created:false and did NOT rewrite name/postcode (immutability holds). No finding — freshest code verified correct. HAPPY-PATH HTTP e2e not reachable: LEAD_INGEST_SECRET not in this env by design, so an authenticated POST cannot be driven; auth-boundary and dedup/immutability proven by other means above. SPEC GAP: /api/ingest/lead has no permanent e2e spec — an auth-boundary spec (401/405) is writable without the secret but the e2e 'public' project depends on the setup auth project, which needs E2E_* creds absent from this env, so no spec could be validated locally and none shipped (AUDIT: a spec must pass locally first). Next run with E2E_* creds: add e2e/public ingest-auth spec (401 no-secret, 405 GET) + a secret-gated happy-path.
